text:
aisha: FYI FinTrust wants a strict-EU POC. They need all tenant traffic pinned to eu-west-1 and BYOK. Can we do tenant-level routing + BYOK for hosted? Also need subprocessor list and an ETA on region pin activation.

matt_eng: short answer — yes we can pin tenant routing for the POC. BYOK is supported but requires the customer's KMS (we need key ARN and grant). if they want full BYOK with no key copies, recommend Dedicated or Private. For hosted pinned tenants we still keep control plane in our region but data path stays in eu-west-1.

jordan_se: @aisha also flag: customer security questionnaire calls out HSM and subproc list (monitoring, error reporting, analytics). Datadog and Sentry are on our subproc list today. do they need us to remove any?

lucy_ops: ops note — we have a tenant-routing policy that can enforce region preference + disable default fallback. however disabling fallback needs ops + infra signoff for capacity/DR. For a short POC (2 wks) we can do a soft pin (preferred->hard pin if capacity ok).

marco_legal: legal note — disabling fallbacks/replication to other regions is an exception; we'll need a signed exception and updated DPA amendment for residency guarantees. also forward security questionnaire answers to us (Q1/Q2).

aisha: good. pricing question from the buyer: does pinning to eu-west-1 or using BYOK change per-token pricing? they asked whether there's an EU surcharge.

zoe_pricing: short: hosted pinned -> 15% regional surcharge for dedicated egress + additional BYOK ops fee (one-time onboarding ~$2.5k). Dedicated/Private pricing different (monthly reserved). i can DM exact numbers for the quote.

matt_eng: technical snippet (what we'll apply for the POC routing):

```yaml
tenant_routing:
  tenant_id: "fintrust-poc"
  preference: "eu-west-1"  # preferred region
  fallback_policy: "disabled"  # ops/legal exception required
  kms:
    mode: "customer_managed"
    key_arn: "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-xxxx"
```

matt_eng: also to note: if they use streaming, we need to verify session affinity TTLs for the pinned pool so KV cache stays hot. will run a smoke test once ops enables the pin.

lucy_ops: ops timeline: if legal signs the exception today and customer provides KMS info + signed PO, we can enable a pin in a sandbox within 48 hours, prod-like pin in ~5 business days (capacity permitting). will schedule maintenance window for activation.

aisha: I'll ask them to fill the SQ (I'll upload), confirm whether Datadog/Sentry are blockers, and get KMS ARN + PO. Also ask if they want fallback disabled or a canary window first.

deploybot: region-pin request received: ticket #RPD-9123 created, assigned to ops. ETA auto-estimate: 48h sandbox / 5d prod.

aisha: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll loop in FinTrust and update this thread with KMS + SQ answers. :thumbsup:
